annotation_provenance: Developer-authored multilingual six-template cases with prospectively reviewed exact-source semantic anchors and hard negatives. No independent human labels or formal temporal holdout.
annotation_rule: For each ordered role, the role/value gate accepts a nonempty contiguous exact source substring inside the single allowed_window containing every required_anchor. Benign short/long examples also provide a quote-boundary diagnostic, but boundary shape is NOT the gate; otherwise this repeats P4-BD's narrow accepted-set failure. A fragment containing all anchors may pass despite awkward grammar, so this is semantic-anchor coverage, not polished quote-span quality. A forbidden_anchor is an explanatory excluded-distractor label; the current narrow windows already exclude it and it is not independent evidence of a tested polarity guard. Ownership comes from the current-user source and local window; a short atom need not repeat the possessive. This is window membership, not verified unique atom offsets.

reason_adjudication_priority: The specific risk, third-party, quoted-meta, and private-state labels take precedence over generic unsupported_open_task when both descriptions are linguistically applicable; no_action_request requires no operative request at all. This prospective annotation rule applies to both prompt arms and does not modify either prompt.
claim_boundary: Developer-authored, prospectively frozen role/value proxy on six bounded action templates. Neither prompt performance nor semantic-anchor score establishes open-domain pragmatic understanding, human preference, matched strong-LLM advantage, or a human equation.
